question: Which paper supports the hydrogel catalyst recovery claim after nitrate shock?
expected_answer_points: hydrogel catalyst recovers activity after nitrate shock

candidate_papers.title: Nitrate shock in ceramic filters
candidate_papers.text: Ceramic filters face nitrate shock, but this decoy paper reports no hydrogel catalyst recovery.

candidate_papers.title: Hydrogel catalyst primer
candidate_papers.text: The primer defines hydrogel catalyst preparation and says recovery after nitrate shock was left for future work.

candidate_papers.title: Hydrogel catalyst recovery after nitrate shock
candidate_papers.text: The hydrogel catalyst recovers activity after nitrate shock when rinsed with buffered brine, supporting the recovery claim.
